form.label: ClinicalHarmony — Trace by correlation id
form.description: Every log line, from every service, for one correlation id: mllp-… (MLLP intake), rest-… (REST intake), ui-… (the dashboard), gen-… (the data-generator), or any X-Correlation-Id a caller sent. Kafka-driven work carries the intake's id through Bronze, Silver, Gold and the PMI.

table.title: Click a Bronze / Silver / master id to open it in the ClinicalHarmony dashboard.

search.query: index=clinicalharmony (correlationId="$cid$" OR requestId="$cid$") | eval time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | rename rawMessageId AS bronze, silverPatientId AS silver, masterPatientId AS master | table time service level event message bronze silver master topic partition offset durationMs | sort time

index=clinicalharmony (correlationId="$cid$" OR requestId="$cid$") | stats min(_time) AS first max(_time) AS last count AS lines BY service | eval seconds=round(last-first,3) | sort first | table service seconds lines
